title: Key West Private 6-Person Sandbar & Snorkeling Charter
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Your Day, Your Way!
Step aboard our 24’ center console and discover the best of Key West’s stunning waters! Perfect for groups of up to six people, this private, captain-guided adventure takes you through crystal-clear waters to beautiful sandbars and unspoiled beaches that can only be reached by boat. With comfortable seating and a T-top for shade, you’ll have everything you need for a fun and relaxing day exploring the breathtaking beauty of the Florida Keys!
